Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] Senator [[Jay Rockefeller]] was re-elected by over three quarters of the vote to a third consecutive term. This was the best election performance of Rockefeller's career. ==Democratic primary== ===Candidates=== * Bruce Barilla, Christian activist * [[Jay Rockefeller]], incumbent U.S. senator ===Results===
